verdicts.reason: A is broken: the can product is shrunk to a thumbnail and the Shop Sale button covers it. The lilac circle sits awkwardly under the subhead, and the bottom two-thirds of the canvas is empty, with the legal line stranded at the bottom. B follows a sensible top-to-bottom story order (headline, subhead, CTA, product, legal) and keeps the can whole and in proportion. Its flaws: the purple circle crashes into the headline and is cropped at the right edge, the CTA is jammed right under the subhead, the oversized product feels heavy against the tight type block, and the legal text is almost as large as the subhead.
